name: Knockfierna

attributes.attribute: twin to the sacred hill Knockainy seven miles away
fairy king said to reside there

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Knockfierna is an Irish mythological site. It carries the names Cnoc Firinne and Knockfeerina. The hill is called the hill of truth. It forms a sister site with Knockainy, a sacred hill seven miles away. Knockfierna offered a doorway to the Otherworld. People gathered at the hill each year for Lughnasa. Several hills near Co. Limerick hold links to the fairies. The fairy king Donn Firinne made his home here. Some people tie him to the king of the Otherworld, who bears the same name Donn.
